gloss: margin (of a page); outside a column or field

definitions.gloss: margin (of a page); outside a column or field
definitions.explanation: The space outside the main text area on a page, form, or document. Used for marginal notes, annotations, or references.

examples.japanese: {欄外|らんがい}にメモを{書|か}く。
examples.english: Write a note in the margin.

examples.japanese: {注釈|ちゅうしゃく}は{欄外|らんがい}に{記載|きさい}されている。
examples.english: The annotations are printed in the margin.

examples.japanese: {申請書|しんせいしょ}の{欄外|らんがい}に{補足|ほそく}{説明|せつめい}を{加|くわ}えた。
examples.english: I added a supplementary note in the margin of the application form.

notes:
A compound of {欄|らん} (column, field, section) and {外|がい} (outside). Refers to any space outside the designated text area or form fields on a printed page or document.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {欄外|らんがい}に{記入|きにゅう}する: to write in the margin
- {欄外|らんがい}{注|ちゅう}: marginal note, footnote
- {欄外|らんがい}{参照|さんしょう}: marginal reference
- {欄外|らんがい}メモ: margin note

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {余白|よはく}: blank space, margin — refers to the white/empty space itself, whereas {欄外|らんがい} emphasizes being "outside the designated area"
- {脚注|きゃくちゅう}: footnote — a specific type of annotation at the bottom of a page
- {注釈|ちゅうしゃく}: annotation, commentary — the content of notes, regardless of where they appear
